procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Diabetes follow-up, about 3 months postpartum. Back at work part-time since the new year. Son home and followed by the pediatric team.

Sugars: fasting 140-180, evenings variable, misses the lunch check on work days. No lows since November. Same insulin doses. Says she ran out of the prenatal vitamin after the holidays and hasn't restarted.

PHQ-9 2.

Exam: well. Weight close to pre-pregnancy. Feet normal, monofilament intact.

OB discharge summary from October reviewed - consistent with her account.

A/P
DM1 - A1c today. Same regimen. We talked again about an endocrinology referral or a sensor; she wants to wait until work settles.
Hypothyroid - postpartum TSH in October was normal; recheck at physical.
Physical in April.

documents.title: Optometry diabetic eye examination
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Date of service 06/05/2026. Annual dilated exam for type 1 diabetes.
Best corrected acuity 20/20 right and left. Tonometry within normal limits.
Fundus, dilated: discs pink and sharp, maculae clear, no retinal hemorrhage, microaneurysm, exudate or new vessels in either eye.
Impression: no evidence of diabetic retinopathy.
Return one year.
